newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toho Zinc to lift zinc output. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Toho Zinc to lift zinc output. [CORRECTED 10:00 GMT]

text.p: Toho Zinc Co said on Wednesday it plans to boost refined zinc output at its Annaka smelter in Gumma prefecture by 5,000 tonnes per year in each of the next two years, from 120,000 tonnes in the fiscal year through March 31, 1997 (Corrects from 1996).
Output will rise to 125,000 tonnes in 1997/98 and 130,000 tonnes in 1998/99, a company spokesman said.
He added, however, that there would be no increase in the smelter's capacity of 139,200 tonnes per year.
He said the decision to boost output reflected strong domestic demand for the metal.
Japan's zinc smelters have also benefited from the recent weakness in the yen and stronger world zinc prices.
